request_text:
Our accident reconstruction company, Kauderer & Associates is investigating a car accident that occurred at the stop light intersection of Golden Gate Avenue and Leavenworth Street on 3/6/19. We are interested in receiving the signal timing and phasing diagram for that intersection. We would like the information to include the date of 3/6/2019. If the timing has changed since then, can we also receive that information as well.

Thank you.
